source: Instagram reel DTktENHEa9L (Rajashekar, 'Boss hook step', song from Mana Shankara Vara Prasad Garu); reference only, never published

clips.name: Belt hold knee-knocks into sumo squat
moves: thumbs hooked in the waistband, elbows out
knees knock in and out alternately while the heels swivel (pigeon-toe to turn-out)
hop down at 6.0 into a deep sumo squat
both hands up beside the ears, fingers spread, held 6.2-6.9

clips.name: Side-on crouch walk, collar grip
moves: body turned to screen-right, torso bent forward ~35 deg
one hand grips the jacket collar at the shoulder
other arm forward, fist with thumb up
small walking steps on the spot, feet cross, knees soft

clips.name: Hands on knees, torso sways
moves: wide stance, both hands on the knees
torso leans left then right, shoulders roll, head drops
pushes up to standing at 10.8

clips.name: Belt pull knee-knocks, squat flash, side pose
moves: both hands grip the trousers at the waist
knees knock alternately, heels twist
12.7 quick sumo squat, hands up
13.0 snaps to the side-on crouch pose

clips.name: Phone torch step
moves: right hand holds a phone with the torch on, left hand on the hip
phone path per 4 counts: up at the shoulder (1), elbow lifts so the forearm is level across the chest (2), up beside the face (3), swings down to the waist (4)
feet: heel touches out to the side alternating with a cross step, small travel forward and back
head nods on each count

clips.name: Phone step reprise, phone swings down
moves: same phone path once more
19.6-20.0 the phone arm swings down and out, hands go to the waist

clips.name: Hands-on-hips swagger, knee lifts
moves: both hands on the hips
knee lifts and kicks, travelling side to side
torso leans back, head turned, mouth open (shouting)
21.8 arms come forward into the roll

clips.name: Forearm roll + boss arm, belt knock
moves: forearms roll around each other at waist height with a knee lift
one forearm level across the chest, other hand flicks below it
23.6-24.6 belt-grip knee-knock with the torso tilted and head turned

clips.name: Roll, swing, collar pop, jacket flick
moves: forearm roll with a knee lift
arm swing across
26.0-26.5 hands at the collar, head thrown back
26.6-27.0 flicks the jacket open, arms out

clips.name: Roll, hand flick, belt knock head-up
moves: forearm roll with a knee lift
hand flick
28.2-29.2 belt-grip knee-knock, torso tilted, head turned up

clips.name: Phone out, point at camera, walk in
moves: right hand pulls the phone from the back pocket
arm extends, phone pointed at the camera
walks toward the camera
clips.note: the original ends on a photo of the actor on the phone screen: replace (no real-person likeness)
